name: workerdeck
description: The self-hosted application control plane for Cloudflare.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @workerdeck/dashboard && npm run build -w @workerdeck/contracts && npm run build -w @workerdeck/provider && npm run build -w @workerdeck/cli && npm run build -w @workerdeck/control-plane
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @workerdeck/dashboard && npm run deploy -w @workerdeck/control-plane
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build -w @workerdeck/dashboard && npm run build -w @workerdeck/control-plane
